Body.Content:
Video Indexer will soon be available free in preview. This new service will represent one of the industry’s most comprehensive video AI services. It'll help you unlock insights from any video by enabling you to search on faces that appeared, spoken audio that is transcribed and translated, and even emotions and objects. With these insights, you'll be able to improve discoverability of videos in your applications, or increase user engagement by embedding this capability in consumer facing sites. All of these capabilities will be available through a simple set of APIs, ready-to-use widgets, and a management portal. 

Read more about Video Indexer
